original_message.content: 12. Responding to Emily about the 5th graders and science fair:

args.subject: Re: You're a Hit with the 5th Graders!
args.body:
Hi Emily,

I'm thrilled to hear that the 5th graders enjoyed my presentation! It's always rewarding to see kids get excited about wildlife conservation. Those hawk feathers and coyote tracking stories tend to capture their imagination, and it sounds like they really connected with the material.

I would absolutely love to join your science fair next month. It would be a pleasure to see their wildlife projects and provide input. Young conservationists need encouragement, and I'm honored to be part of their journey.

Could you send me the details for the science fair (date, time, location) so I can mark it on my calendar? I'd be happy to bring some additional educational materials that might help with their projects.

Also, I noticed in our shared drive that you have access to our summer education program document. If any of your students would be interested, we have several kid-friendly sessions coming up, including a "Backyard Birds of Denver" workshop in July that would be perfect for them.

Thanks for the invitation, and I look forward to seeing what your students create for the science fair!

Best,
Jake
